Welcome!

About us

We are a group of musicians who also love education, tech and software.

Here you’ll see themes about learning and education, equipment, jam and gig logistics.

We intend to reduce friction from being able to do what we love most: Read, Write, Produce, Listen and/or Play!

Much of the projects will be freely accessible via open source for folks to play around with, and give feedback. Some may lead to either free or low cost service offerings available online.

Project candidates

The following are some of the projects at the inception phase:

  • SuperJamm: Herd the cats during Open Jams
  • Practice Rig: Some examples of modern practice rig setups
  • Practice Guide: Organize practice sessions inline with a focused learning path

Feel free to reach out to us at admin@muze-interactive.live, especially if you want a sounding board for ideas, have questions, or even just geek out over music or gear.
